topic: Insaan ke sharir ki sabse badi haddi
subject: Science
caption:
Insaan ke sharir ki sabse badi haddi kaun hai? 🤔 Jawaab hai Femur, lekin kahani yahin khatam nahi hoti!

🦴 Femur: jaangh ki haddi, sabse lambi aur sabse mazboot
💪 Poore sharir ka wazan sambhalti hai
👂 Stapes: sabse chhoti haddi, kaan ke andar
🔨 Ear ossicles: Malleus, Incus, Stapes
🧠 Trick: Femur bada, Stapes chhota

Comment karo: Stapes haddi kahan milti hai? A) Kaan mein B) Naak mein
